title: The Parable of the Unworthy Servant
description: Jesus teaches the disciples: He warns against causing others to stumble, commands unlimited forgiveness for a brother who repents, and speaks of the power of faith like a mustard seed that can uproot a mulberry tree. He concludes with the parable of the servant returning from the field, reminding the disciples that even after doing all they are commanded, they are merely 'unworthy servants' who have only done their duty.
